background: JPMorgan Chase & Co. is the holding company of the largest US bank, spanning consumer and community banking, the corporate and investment bank, commercial banking and asset and wealth management.
synthesis: The group is rated A+ on average across all three main agencies, the weakest of them at A, all on a stable outlook; the last move was a one-notch upgrade by one of the three on 15 Nov 2024. Leverage of 7.5% is in the top quarter of US banks, the only ratio held for it. The newest flagged item, on 21 Aug 2026, is another round of layoffs as job cuts mount, and the others cover a political-debanking lawsuit; staffing and litigation rather than balance-sheet concerns.
